subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel be default-on behavior in the bundled Discord plugin, or should maintainers require opt-in or narrower semantics before merging the linked PR?
rationale: Current main lacks the feature, but the linked implementation changes existing Discord session and cancellation behavior for live users, which needs maintainer product intent beyond source inspection.

options.title: Accept default-on after proof
options.body: Land the linked PR path once code review and live Discord proof show edits reprocess and deletes cancel only source-message work.

options.title: Require opt-in behavior
options.body: Ask the PR to add a narrow Discord config gate or staged rollout before current users get edit/delete behavior.

options.title: Split cancellation semantics
options.body: Ship edit-to-reprocess first and track delete-to-cancel separately if cancellation is too risky for the same change.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on after proof
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR path once code review and live Discord proof show edits reprocess and deletes cancel only source-message work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the Discord listener, dispatch, startup, handler, and queue surfaces that would carry the final semantics.
